name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.0.3.

Cleaner messages: your shop name in every customer message now shows on its own, without the Tally financial-year tag that used to appear after it.

Clearer setup: at first sync, the company you pick is now easy to read (the name was showing in white before).

Steadier WhatsApp: if a second copy of ASVA ever starts, it now steps aside instead of knocking your WhatsApp offline.

Owner control: send a firm, formal reminder to one customer only when YOU decide, with LETTER <name> on the ASVA assistant. ASVA never gets harsher on its own.

Free for every shop until 30 September 2026.
